# MDWFP flies east-west transects from the Mississippi River to the hill line and
# counts every duck in a 250 m strip

# source in this repo that actually measures the second half of January.
# The whole record comes from four PDFs: each report's Table 1 prints the full
# historical series for its own survey period.
# TEAL ARE NOT EXCLUDED. MDWFP reports only Mallards / Other Dabblers / Diving

# winged teal are long gone from the Delta by the mid-November first flight
# the exposure is green-winged teal only.
